title: Confidence
description: The ONE stated-confidence scale shared by every advocate, step-verifier, and arbiter payload in the external-review pattern, so a stated confidence means the same thing everywhere. This file defines the value domain ONLY; the SEMANTICS (when a payload must state it, what governs the call) live in flow-external-review + the standard-judging constitution. Referenced by co-located schemas via {"$ref": "confidence.schema.json"}.
